displayName: Epoch AI Benchmarking Hub — internal runs

completeness.expectedCountMethod: Inspect all ZIP entries and separate nine internal CSVs (no _external suffix) from 64 external-source CSVs.

notes: Only files without the _external suffix are treated as Epoch-run evidence.
The ECI contributes a dynamic Top 20 selection set, deduplicated by base model and retained as excluded, selection-only evidence.
When a base model has tied ECI scores, the profile with the highest declared reasoning effort is retained deterministically.
This bounded fixture includes current GPT-5.6 profiles on four mapped internal benchmarks; other internal rows remain in the indexed ZIP artifact.
